name: Am I the Asshole
source: MC deals with depression, PTSD (childhood trauma), and various other personality disorders. His depression got so bad that he tried to take his own life a few years ago. His wife found him after he overdosed on his medication. She was so shocked and hurt by the MC's action that she set strict boundaries for him. At this point, they are separated. They have a girl and a boy together. Will there ever be some reconciliation, or what will be our MC's path?
translation: MC治疗抑郁症、PTSD（童年创伤）和各种其他人格障碍。几年前，他的抑郁症变得非常严重，以至于他试图结束自己的生命。他服药过量后，他的妻子找到了他。她对主持人的行为感到非常震惊和受伤，因此她为他设定了严格的界限。至此，他们分开了。他们有一个女孩和一个男孩。会有和解吗？或者我们的MC会走什么路？
